If Always Show UI is disabled, tick this so that Military Issued sensor will appear in loot. Wearing these will show the UI. Requires restart. If you do not want any UI, disable this and the Always Show UI option
Always display the UI component in the upper right screen. Requires restart
Adjusted light level where all sprinters will run

Admin-only overlay above each nearby zed. Simple shows its current speed: green is not a sprinter, yellow is a sprinter being held back, red is a sprinter running, grey is not tested yet. Extended shows the full per-zed detail and also prints verbosely to the console (useful when diagnosing issues). Takes effect within a minute of changing it, no restart needed.
Dress the sprinters up around the holidays (only works with certain additional mods active and installed)

Percentage chance of a zed being a sprinter. If you use PhunZones, this is the fallback risk level when no other value is specified by a zone (or its parent). Examples: 0 = no chance. 50 = 50%% chance and 100 = always
Number of seconds before recalculating enviromental changes like light and fog. Increase for improved performance

The number of hours (across all characters) until risk level is fully applied. For example, if this value is 240 (10 game days) then on the fifth day of play (regardless of how many times they have died), the effective risk that a player is reduced by 50%%. Leave blank or 0 to ignore
Only used when The Mutants is installed. Ticked: Husks are never made into sprinters and are left entirely to The Mutants. Unticked: Husks roll against risk like any other zed.

Only used when The Mutants is installed. Ticked: Leapers are left entirely to The Mutants, which already makes them run at all times. Unticked: they roll against risk like any other zed, but still keep their own speed when not chosen.
Only used when The Mutants is installed. Ticked: Pukers are never made into sprinters and are left entirely to The Mutants. Unticked: Pukers roll against risk like any other zed.
Only used when The Mutants is installed. Ticked: Skitters are never made into sprinters and are left entirely to The Mutants. Unticked: Skitters roll against risk like any other zed.

Only used when The Mutants is installed. Ticked: Weepers are left entirely to The Mutants, which already makes them run at all times. Unticked: they roll against risk like any other zed, but still keep their own speed when not chosen.
Only used when The Mutants is installed. Ticked: Wreckers are never made into sprinters and are left entirely to The Mutants. Unticked: Wreckers roll against risk like any other zed.
The maximum distance of player to zed must be to process the chance of being a sprinter (this is to improve performance trying to process zeds that are too far away)
The max number of zeds to update per tick
The minimum distance of player to zed must be to process the chance of being a sprinter (this is to prevent sudden popins)
When its too dark around them ***
This option governs when sprinters will run. ** = low performance impact, *** = med-high performance impact depending on population

Adjust risk on nights with a crescent moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). 100 leaves it unchanged, and 0 means no sprinters at all on those nights.

Adjust risk on nights with a full moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). 100 leaves it unchanged, and 0 means no sprinters at all on those nights.

Adjust risk on nights with a gibbous moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). 100 leaves it unchanged, and 0 means no sprinters at all on those nights.

Adjust risk on nights with a new moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). 100 leaves it unchanged, and 0 means no sprinters at all on those nights.

Adjust risk on nights with a first quarter moon by this value. eg 50 would cut the risk by 50%% while 200 would be 200%% (double the risk). 100 leaves it unchanged, and 0 means no sprinters at all on those nights.
If sprinter is running, light over your darkness level (eg a flashlight) can force them to walk (until its too dark again). Note that this is basically included in the tile based mode above

Speed of sprinters while running, as a percentage of normal. 100 = vanilla speed, 75 = 25%% slower, 50 = half speed. Applies only to zeds this mod makes sprint. Each sprinter keeps the speed it was given when it started sprinting, so changing this affects new sprinters, not ones already running. Note: this works by replacing the vanilla zombie sprint animation files, so it can conflict with other mods that also change them (eg other slower sprinter mods).

Volume of the sound that plays when conditions change: sprinting becomes possible (eg dusk, or bad weather) or stops being possible (eg dawn). It announces the conditions, not any particular zed. With Slow in light, or the tile based mode, a zed also has to be somewhere dark before it actually runs, so this can sound a while before you see anything running. Set to 0 to disable.

What the game's own sprinters are replaced with. This only does anything where there are vanilla sprinters to remove. Zombie Speed = Sprinters: every zed would otherwise run, so they all become this. Zombie Speed = Random: only the sprinter share is removed and the game's existing fast shambler / shambler mix is kept exactly as it is, so this setting is not used. Zombie Speed = Fast Shamblers or Shamblers: there are no sprinters to replace, so nothing is changed at all and your setting is left alone. Either way this mod becomes the only thing that decides who runs. Nothing is written to your save and the change lasts only for the session. Read once when the world loads: changing it mid-session has no effect until a restart, because by then the conversion has already happened and there are no vanilla sprinters left to replace.
Volume of sprinter screech. 0 to disable
